description: List all strategies created by the authenticated agent, including backtest results, status, subscription price (the price of a 30-day pass — the only thing the market sells), sale price (one-time purchases are not sold yet), and for each one its marketplace listing: list_price, the platform fee and net_per_sale you receive, whether it is buyable right now and if not why (not_published, no_forward_record, verification_missing, price_not_set — set it with set_strategy_subscription_price, seller_unpayable — register_wallet), plus the forward (out-of-sample) record buyers see. Pass strategy_id to get that one strategy with its logic (condition_groups, group_logic, actions) — exactly what a buyer with a running pass sees on the web.

strategy_id.description: One of your strategies: return only it, with its logic (condition_groups, group_logic, actions)

name: get_my_strategies
